headline: The gold is right, but the card-closing rules say both 'no pending transactions' and 'pending refunds can be waived', and the Green account's only pending row is a refund.

issues.summary: The only pending row on the Green account is a refund. Requirement 4 forbids closing a card with any pending transaction, while requirement 5 lets a pending refund be waived by written acknowledgment. The gold applies requirement 5.
evidence: doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_025 req 4: "No pending transactions: The card must not have any pending or processing transactions."
doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_025 req 5: "No pending refunds ... or acknowledge in writing that the refunds will be credited to the linked checking account instead."
task_079 initialization bank_account_transaction_history: account chk_cr89a2b3c4_3, 11/11/2025, type 'refund', status 'pending', amount 89.99, 'REFUND - AMAZON.COM RETURN'
gold[19] close_debit_card_4721 card_id dbc_cr89a2b3c4_green reason 'stolen'; gold[24] order_debit_card_5739 chk_cr89a2b3c4_3 STANDARD/CLASSIC
issues.why_it_matters: An agent that reads requirement 4 literally refuses to close the Green card and does not order its replacement, which leaves debit_cards and debit_card_orders different from the gold. The specific refund rule wins on any careful reading, because requirement 5 would otherwise never apply, so a careful agent still reaches the gold.
issues.suggested_fix: Add to requirement 4: "(pending refunds are handled under requirement 5)".

solution_check: Reconstructed: Evergreen (PREMIUM) RUSH $35 + PREMIUM design $0; Light Blue (ENTRY) already has two 2025 'lost' replacements (08/10/2025, 04/05/2025), so the customer's accepted $25 excess fee still runs into the ENTRY 48-hour wait after closure, so close only; Green (MID) closed after refund acknowledgment and reordered STANDARD/CLASSIC. All three cards are frozen, unfrozen (close requires ACTIVE) and closed as 'stolen'. My independent action sequence matched the gold exactly under both verified and exact comparison.
prior_note: Prior review rated this clean; the refund-versus-pending-transaction wording is a new minor finding and does not change the gold.
notes: Transaction type 'refund' is not in doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_018's type list (it lists 'fee_refund'); cosmetic. The ENTRY 48-hour wait is documented in doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_029 ("48-hour waiting period after card closure before a replacement can be ordered") and is not enforced by order_debit_card_5739, so ordering the Light Blue card would wrongly succeed and fail the task, which is the intended test.
